editorial:
Tim is an orphan boy who is afraid of the dark, but his world changes when the stars start disappearing from the sky. He discovers that the night is a hidden world full of strange creatures and magic, and he teams up with the Cat Shepherd, a mysterious guide who knows its secrets. Together they travel through dreamy, shadowy places to find out what is stealing the light. The movie has a soft, storybook look and a gentle mood that feels like a bedtime tale come to life. It is not loud or flashy, but it pulls you in with its quiet charm and sense of wonder.

The animation is hand-drawn and beautiful, with warm colors that make the dark feel cozy instead of scary. The pacing is slow and calm, great for younger kids but maybe sleepy for older viewers. The story is simple and easy to follow, though some parts feel rushed near the end. If you enjoy gentle family films with a touch of mystery, this one is a nice pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Tim and the Cat Shepherd discover that the stars are being stolen by a dark force that feeds on fear. Tim realizes his own fear of the dark is part of what gives it power. By facing his fear and choosing to be brave, he helps restore the stars to the sky. The Cat Shepherd reveals he was guiding Tim all along to teach him this lesson. The night returns to normal, and Tim is no longer afraid of the dark.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gentle animated family films with a touch of mystery.
